title: Four Siblings on House Porch Steps, 1967 B&W Family Snapshot Photo
description: A candid December 1967 square black-and-white snapshot showing four young siblings gathered on the wooden steps of their family home porch. A boy stands in the screen doorway holding a playground ball, while an older girl wearing glasses holds a barefoot toddler on her lap. Beside them sits another smiling girl in a floral print top, capturing intimate mid-century suburban family life.
